fields.label: About Content
fields.name: about_content
fields.instructions:
There is a little magic under the hood here. Ensure you have added your gifs in the Theme Settings under the About Page Gifs tab.
Next you are required to connect your gifs with a shortcode.
The shortcode has several attributes:
  • - content(any text, default: filler, required)
  • - img(URL, default: silly gif, required)
  • - top(value, default: auto, optional)
  • - bottom(value, default: auto, optional)
  • - left(value, default: auto, optional)
  • - right(value, default: auto, optional)

Shortcode format: i.e. [gif_insert content="keyword" img="https://gif-URL.example" top="48rem" bottom="auto" left="32rem" right="auto"]

The keyword can be whatever you want it to be. It will be placed in the page's HTML in a special < span > tag that will be accompanied by the gif URL you provide.
The keyword will also appear in the paragraph as underlined text.

The img must be a gif or other image URL. It will be placed in the page's HTML in a < img > tag.

The top, bottom, left, and right can each be used to set the gifs location on the page.
+ and - values are valid.
It is recommended to use rem, vh, vw, or px as value units. 0 does not need a unit.

Each of the following are valid examples: top="100px", top="24rem", bottom="10vh", left="0", right="20vw", or right="auto"
